title: Satellite Maintenance Window Insertion
description: An orbital operations center tracks existing satellite maintenance windows as a list of non-overlapping time intervals, sorted by start time. You are given a new maintenance window with its start and end times. Insert the new window into the existing schedule, merging any overlapping intervals if necessary to ensure all maintenance periods remain strictly disjoint and properly ordered.
constraints: intervals is sorted by start_i in ascending order
input_format: A 2D array of integers representing existing intervals and an array of 2 integers representing the new interval.
output_format: A 2D array of integers representing the updated list of intervals.

examples.explanation: The new interval [2, 5] overlaps with [1, 3], resulting in the merged interval [1, 5].
The new interval [4, 8] overlaps with [3, 5], [6, 7], and [8, 10], combining them into [3, 10].
The schedule is initially empty, so the new interval is the only one returned.
